The repo has no policy docs, so the decision comes from claude-mem's prompt history for this session. At 8:10 AM the record says "plain HTTP for internal hosts". At 8:13 AM it says "https everywhere, no exceptions". I treated the later entry as replacing the earlier one, and the file doesn't mention the retired plain-HTTP position.

Those two entries are short prompts, and I couldn't open their full text, so I'm reading the later one as a reversal from its wording and timestamp alone. If it was meant as something narrower, the file needs changing.
